thread.title: Amazon Passes Alphabet To Achieve This Prestigious Position

author: BRIAN DEAGON
title: Amazon Passes Alphabet To Achieve This Prestigious Position
text:
Amazon ( AMZN ) on Tuesday passed Google-owner Alphabet ( GOOGL ) as the world's second most valuable company, with Apple ( AAPL ) the only one in its path to the top.
X
Amazon shares rose 2.7% to 1,586.51 on the stock market today , providing it a market valuation of $768 billion. Alphabet fell 0.4% to 1,095.80, with a market value at $762.5 billion. Alphabet, since hitting a record high of 1,197 on Jan. 29, is down 8.5%.
Apple closed at 175.24, down a fraction, with a market cap of $889.17 billion
Shares of Amazon are up 85% over the past 12 months, rising 35% this year.

Along with Amazon's wealth has grown the wealth of company founder and Chief Executive Jeff Bezos, who early this month ascended to the top spot as the richest man on the planet , according to Forbes' annual listing of billionaires. The magazine estimated Bezos has a net worth of $112 billion, making him the first and only "centi-billionaire"— exceeding the $100 billion mark.
